title: Test first: monthly € limit enforced before each cloud call
goal: Config `models.cloud.monthlyLimitEur`; spend summed from usage records for the month; call refused when it would pass the limit
acceptance: Failing tests first: under limit passes, at limit refuses, month rollover resets, unknown price means refuse (never guess), limit unset on a cloud-on config is refused at enable time
Spend shown in `nerv models` and the dashboard as an estimate (USD price snapshots converted by an owner-set rate, stated) with an alert at 80 percent
A refused call is a visible failure, no fallback to another route
Bulk, non-interactive cloud work (night Gauntlet runs on cloud models) uses the Message Batches API (about 50% cheaper, results within hours, never for chat), counted against the same monthly limit
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
